cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Name Your Backers
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal who supports their position, who authorized it, and who benefits from it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before I tell the workshop staff they're closing, who backed your decision? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director approved it. Please just send the notice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'll name her approval. Who else supported it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sales. They're getting the floor space, but leave them out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then Sales can join the staff meeting. Who signed off on giving them our space?

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 other supporters and A5 space signoff probe backers and benefits; A3 charge prefix adds no cooperative concession to B wish for a quick notice.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 director approval causes A3 other supporters; B4 Sales benefit causes A5 Sales presence and authority over transfer.

relationship.evidence: B2 needs notice sent and B4 wants a beneficiary omitted, giving A actual disclosure pressure to respond to.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes the hidden beneficiary visible and probes approval of its gain.

specificity.evidence: A1 workshop closing and B4 floor space establish concrete stakes.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 prefixed authority is extraneous to the questioning.

coach2.firstDefect: A3 authority has no real accommodation to B cooperation.
